name: TheSaaSDirectory

sources.title: TheSaaSDirectory homepage — SaaS-only categories, 'Create Listing' entry point
Create Listing page — requires login/registration before submitting
Register page — 'this directory is for SaaS/PE/VC only', manual review notice

requirements: SaaS company (or PE/VC entity) only — 'please don't bother posting spam or unrelated businesses'
All new listings are manually reviewed
Account registration required before the listing form is accessible
preparation: SaaS company details for the listing form: name, description, website, category
Featured listing spots exist — featured status may be editorial or paid (not documented on fetched pages)
workflow: Complete the listing form and submit
Confirm the listing appears under /listings/ in the appropriate category
watchFor: The submissionUrl in the batch (/submit) returns 404 — the real path is /create-listing/ after login
No paid listing tiers were visible on public pages, but 'Featured Listings' exist on the homepage — featured placement mechanics are undocumented
Listing detail pages are long-form — prepare a substantial company description, not just a tagline
countsAsLive: A public listing page under thesaasdirectory.com/listings/ in the chosen SaaS category, reachable without login
unknowns: Whether featured placement is paid or editorial, and its cost
Whether listing links to the company site are dofollow
